section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM - Instruments and Sender Gauges
title: Water temp. gauge - Defective indication

content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for water temperature gauge defective indication

steps.text: With the ignition S/W at ON position, is indicator segment at lowest point when connector of water temp. sender gauge disconnected?

branches.action: Check short circuit in wire harness

next_check.if_no: Bad wiring (short-circuit) between sensor and meter

steps.text: With the ignition S/W at ON position and connector of water temp. sender gauge disconnected, does top segment flash when connector is grounded?

branches.action: Is water temp. sender gauge OK? (See page BE-55)
Check open circuit in wire harness between sensor and meter
